profile.name: emeis Société anonyme
profile.summary: emeis Société anonyme operates nursing homes, assisted-living facilities, post-acute and rehabilitation hospitals, retirement homes, and psychiatric hospitals. Its services include concierge, housekeeping, ironing, internet connection, TV, telephone, free shuttles, catering and event organization, logistics support, DIY and gardening assistance, IT support, beauty and relaxation treatments, furniture on rent, fitness and wellness areas, and medical visits. The company's post-acute and rehabilitation hospitals offer services for geriatrics, musculoskeletal, nervous system, cardiovascular, hematology, and oncology conditions, as well as patients in a persistent vegetative state or in a minimally conscious state. Its psychiatric hospitals provide services for patients with mood disorders, anxiety disorders, obsessive-compulsive disorders, addictions, eating disorders, sleep disorders, personality disorders, schizophrenic disorders, autism spectrum disorders, psychotraumatic disorders, neurodegenerative diseases, perinatal psychiatry, and burn-out. It serves patients in France, Germany, Belgium, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Spain, Italy, Portugal, Latin America, Austria, Croatia, Slovenia, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Poland, the United Arab Emirates, and China. The company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Puteaux, France.
profile.summary_fr: emeis Société anonyme exploite des maisons de soins infirmiers, des centres de vie assistée, des hôpitaux post-aiguë et de réadaptation, des maisons de retraite et des hôpitaux psychiatriques. Ses services comprennent conciergerie, ménage, repassage, connexion Internet, TV, téléphone, navettes gratuites, restauration et organisation d'événements, soutien logistique, aide au bricolage et au jardinage, soutien informatique, soins de beauté et de relaxation, meubles à louer, salles de fitness et de bien-être et visites médicales. Les hôpitaux post-aiguë et de réadaptation de la société offrent des services pour les conditions gériatriques, musculo-squelettiques, nerveuses, cardiovasculaires, hématologiques et oncologiques, ainsi que pour les patients dans un état végétatif persistant ou dans un état de conscience minimale.
